title: A ticket that extends a card another ticket built also cites it, and is blocked by that earlier ticket
why: depends_on edges alone leave a ticket with no blocker when it builds on a card with no outgoing edge, so the ticket could start before the code it extends exists.
body: A ticket cites every card it builds, including a card that an earlier ticket first built and this ticket extends. The first ticket that cites a card introduces it. blocked_by then follows two rules: a ticket is blocked by the ticket that introduces each card its own cited cards depend_on, and a ticket is blocked by the ticket that introduces a card it cites and extends. No other order is added.
